releases.body:
Add ESC abort cooldown

- Detects user ESC (MessageAbortedError/AbortError) and skips automatic continuation for 30 seconds
- Gives the user space to regain control without being immediately pulled back
- Continuation resumes automatically after cooldown expires

Add user confirmation guidance to goal_create

- goal_create description now instructs agent to present goal to user before creating
- goal_create output mentions goal_clear as undo path
- README updated with confirmation-first workflow
